messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000917": The Boreal team observed on 2025-12-01 that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, billing API, dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000886" [decision]: The Atlas team owns the image resizer as of 2025-11-26, when ownership transferred from the Ember team.  (about: Atlas team, Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000884": As of the 2025-11-26 handover, the image resizer's dashboards and alerts are being repointed.  (about: image resizer)
- memory_id "1000811": On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer, marketing send)
- memory_id "1000797" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by Cinder; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000793" [constraint]: As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000787" [decision]: Reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex job)
- memory_id "1000783": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex job)
- memory_id "1000779": The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03 during incident INC-2025-023.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000775": The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000668" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-03, the product catalog can be released on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays; the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC slot no longer applies.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000666" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-03, the product catalog can be deployed on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000610": Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle as of 2025-07-30.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman)
- memory_id "1000455": The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: INC-2025-011, index, schema migration)
- memory_id "1000438" [decision]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, when ownership passed from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000417" [decision]: Cinder adopted trunk-based development as of 2025-05-14.  (about: Cinder)
- memory_id "1000412": The Cinder team observed on 2025-05-14 that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher, cache change)
- memory_id "1000363" [constraint]: As of 2025-04-22, the search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11, full reindex)
- memory_id "1000351" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000158": The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
Existing entity names: Boreal team, billing API, dependency bump, Atlas team, Ember team, image resizer, marketing send, Cinder, ledger service, INC-2025-023, reindex job, indexer, product catalog, Priya Raman, INC-2025-011, index, schema migration, webhook dispatcher, cache change, OpenSearch 2.11, full reindex
